entry.title: Russian man who swam from Kaliningrad to Lithuania in asylum attempt sentenced to six years hard labour
entry.content: A 68-year-old Russian man who swam across the Nemunas River from Russia's Kaliningrad exclave into neighbouring Lithuania in an attempt to seek asylum has been sentenced to six years in a strict-regime penal colony in Russia for "publicly justifying terrorism."
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: French prime minister says government not indifferent to students' concerns in TV address
entry.content: In a televised address from his official residence the French prime minister acknowledges young people anger 'doesn't come from nowhere' and promises a plan to respond to the crisis
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Judo: Grigalashvili claims fourth world title as Kaju reigns again
entry.content: Haruka Kaju extended her unbeaten World Judo Tour run to 40 contests, defending her -63kg world title against Kerem Primo. At -81kg, Tato Grigalashvili defeated home favourite Zelim Tckaev to claim his fourth world title and return to the top of the podium.
entry.dc:creator: Sport

entry.title: Walenie południowe wracają do RPA i przyciągają tłumy na wybrzeże
entry.content: W Hermanus w RPA znów pojawiają się południowe walenie, przyciągając tłumy na klify i festiwal, gdy w Walker Bay matki karmią nowo narodzone cielęta.
entry.dc:creator: News (PL)

entry.title: Southern right whales return to South Africa, drawing crowds to the coast
entry.content: Southern right whales return to Hermanus, South Africa, drawing crowds to the cliffs and whale festival as mothers nurse newborn calves in Walker Bay.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Maricarmen, symbol of Spain's housing protests, dies
entry.content: The 87-year-old woman had withstood four eviction attempts in the past decade. In a final message from her hospital bed, she urged protesters: "Fight!"
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Niespodziewany gość na plaży: słoń morski przyciąga tłumy w Rio
entry.content: Na plaży Copacabana w Rio pojawiła się południowa foka słoniowa, przyciągając tłumy, zdjęcia i poruszenie w mediach społecznościowych; władze ustawiły bariery, by ją chronić.

entry.title: Unexpected beach guest: Elephant seal draws crowds in Rio
entry.content: A southern elephant seal surprised Rio’s Copacabana beachgoers, drawing crowds, photos and social media buzz as officials set up barriers to protect it.

entry.title: Trump mocks Sheinbaum over Gulf of Mexico and imitates her alleged reaction: 'No, no, please'
entry.content: The US president says the Mexican leader rang him to urge him not to rename the Gulf of Mexico. Trump justified the change with coastal data that available figures do not support.

entry.title: Rubio in Athens urges Europe to shoulder more of its defence burden
entry.content: The US secretary of state held talks on energy, military cooperation and regional security, pointing to Greece as an example of higher defence spending. The agenda also included LNG, F-35s, the Eastern Mediterranean and the Strait of Hormuz.

entry.title: Knife attack at Polish school: in Ostroleka a student injures seven, two are in critical condition
entry.content: On Wednesday morning at a vocational school in Ostrołęka in Northern Poland, a 19-year-old pupil attacked classmates and teachers with a sharp tool, injuring seven people, two of whom are in a serious condition, police said.

entry.content: Najnowocześniejszy i najmocniejszy w historii marki Jaguar miał dziś premierę w Nowym Jorku, celując w młodszą, zamożną, głównie amerykańską klientelę.

entry.title: Milan looks East: Chinese fashion takes centre stage for traditional craftwork
entry.content: Brocade carries centuries of Chinese history, woven with patterns that have long held meanings beyond decoration. Now, the traditional craft is finding a new expression on the Milan catwalk, as designers reinterpret the fabric for a contemporary audience.

entry.title: Russia dismisses transparency calls amid reports of second Siberia plague case
entry.content: Rospotrebnadzor said nearly 5,000 tests found no dangerous pathogens and saw "no epidemic risk," while the Kremlin called most media reporting "false" and said it had no knowledge of a US demarche formally requesting additional information.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: Deadly drone attacks raise questions over Europe’s Black Sea defences
entry.content: The European Union has a plan to safeguard the Black Sea. But days after drones wreaked havoc along Romania and Bulgaria’s coast, sinking commercial vessels and killing two people, questions loom over how Brussels can protect the sea.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.content: Manfred D., były szef gabinetu byłego szefa wywiadu Augusa Hanninga, został aresztowany za współudział w zdradzie stanu i płatne przekazywanie mu tajnych dokumentów BND od 2010 roku.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe (PL)

entry.title: ‘We will certainly look at it’: Trump says he will consider permanent US military base in Lithuania
entry.content: US President Donald Trump said he would consider Lithuania’s proposal to permanently host US troops after the Baltic country said it was ready to accommodate a permanent American military presence.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Iran grozi uderzeniem wyprzedzającym, a USA pytają, kto rządzi Teheranem
entry.content: Rzecznik armii Iranu oświadczył, że siły Teheranu są gotowe uderzyć pierwsze, jeśli zajdzie taka potrzeba, a IRGC mówi o zaostrzonej kontroli cieśniny Ormuz. Waszyngton pyta, jaką realną władzę mają prezydent Pezeszkian i minister Aragczi.

entry.title: Residents search belongings after Jerusalem building demolished
entry.content: A five-storey building in Jerusalem’s al-Tur was demolished by Israeli authorities over alleged lack of permits, displacing dozens of Palestinian residents.

entry.title: MEPs urge tougher action against China as tensions hit ‘critical point’
entry.content: The resolution calls China “a decisive enabler” of Russia’s war in Ukraine and says the EU should take action against China’s weaponisation of the rare eath minerals that Europe depends on.

entry.title: Exclusive: The Left group wants to halve MEP salaries
entry.content: The proposal would slash MEPs’ net monthly salary from around €8,800 to almost €4,400, but opponents have dismissed it as a “populist stunt”.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: EU hopefuls fear new safeguard plans could create second-class members
entry.content: EU candidate countries fear safeguards designed to prevent democratic backsliding, like a planned 15-year probation period, could create second-class membership and be used to exert political pressure.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.title: Former BND chief's aide arrested as Germany's biggest spy scandal widens
entry.content: Manfred D, former head of cabinet to ex-intelligence chief August Hanning, was taken into custody on charges of aiding and abetting treason. He is accused of obtaining classified BND documents and passing them to Hanning in exchange for payment since 2010.
entry.dc:creator: My Europe

entry.content: Projekt przyjęto stosunkiem głosów 174 do sześciu mimo sprzeciwu rządu. Przewiduje do dwóch lat więzienia, grzywny i chłostę za kontakty z mediami uznanymi przez resort wywiadu za wrogie. Ustawa czeka jeszcze na ocenę Rady Strażników.

entry.title: Italians and Czechs push Brussels to ease green rules as energy crisis hits industry
entry.content: Rome and Prague have joined forces to protect industry ahead of the EU leaders' summit in Brussels next week.

entry.title: Iran threatens pre-emptive strikes as US questions who runs Tehran
entry.content: Iran's army spokesman said Tehran's forces were prepared to strike first "should circumstances require it," while IRGC officials claimed tighter control of Hormuz, and Washington publicly pondered how much authority Pezeshkian and Araghchi actually wielded.

entry.title: Argentyna żegna Messiego po wygranej 3:0 z Beninem w jego ostatnim meczu
entry.content: Piłkarski idol wszech czasów Lionel Messi żegna się wzruszająco z kadrą, prowadząc Argentynę do wygranej 3:0 z Beninem w Buenos Aires. Strzelił gola i zaliczył dwie asysty.

entry.title: Madrid versus Latin America: Where is housing more affordable?
entry.content: Homes cost more per square metre in Madrid than in several major Latin American cities, but lower wages in those cities can make renting even less affordable.

entry.title: Iran parliament votes to criminalise interviews with 'hostile' foreign media
entry.content: The bill passed 174 to six despite cabinet opposition, carrying penalties of up to two years in prison, fines and flogging for Iranians who speak to outlets designated as hostile by the Intelligence Ministry. The bill has not yet become law and faces Guardian Council review.
entry.dc:creator: News

entry.title: UE przeznacza 1,24 mld euro na ukraińskie drony i amunicję
entry.content: Unia Europejska przeznaczyła 1,24 mld euro dla Ukrainy na zakup dronów, systemów przechwytywania i amunicji, także produkowanych w kraju, aby odpierać nasilone rosyjskie ataki z powietrza.

entry.title: France suspends police stun grenades at student protests after teenager loses hand
entry.content: More than 6,500 people, most of them minors, have been arrested since the movement began and one teenager lost his hand when handling a police grenade.

entry.title: Interlaken vs Innsbruck: How Europe’s adventure travel hotspots compare for a winter holiday
entry.content: These Alpine adventure destinations offers snow-covered slopes, unique hotels and local delicacies. But between Interlaken and Innsbruck, where should you choose to travel this winter?

entry.title: EU agrees to sanction over 1,600 people and entities linked to Russia's war
entry.content: The EU will soon add over 1,600 names, including 77 lawmakers who stood for election in the occupied territories of Ukraine, to its Russia sanctions. The decision comes amid an unsettling rise in hybrid attacks.

entry.title: Naukowcy opisują egipskiego krokodyla z czaszką bez nosa jak Sfinks
entry.content: Czaszka znaleziona prawie sto lat temu pozwoliła naukowcom z Egiptu i Europy zmienić drzewo rodowe krokodyli, odsłaniając związek ze Sfinksem.
entry.dc:creator: News (PL)

entry.title: Scientists identify ancient Egyptian crocodile whose skull is missing its nose like the Sphinx
entry.content: A skull found nearly a century ago has helped Egyptian and European researchers revise part of the crocodile family tree, shedding light on the Mediterranean's prehistoric wildlife and revealing an unexpected connection to the Great Sphinx.

entry.content: USA, Chiny i UE w odmienny sposób regulują sztuczną inteligencję. Jak największe gospodarki świata podchodzą do tej technologii i co jest stawką.

entry.title: Hungary set to lift veto on Ukraine's EU membership talks
entry.content: Hungary dropped its veto on two clusters of Ukraine's EU accession talks on Wednesday. The next phase depends on Kyiv's parliament passing a minority-rights law.

entry.title: Atak nożownika w szkole w Ostrołęce. Siedem osób rannych, dwie w stanie ciężkim
entry.content: W środowy poranek w szkole zawodowowej w Ostrołęce (woj. mazowieckie) 19-letni uczeń zaatakował ostrym narzędziem zarówno kolegów, jak i nauczycieli. Policja przekazała, że rannych zostało siedem osób, dwie z nich znajdują się w stanie ciężkim.

entry.title: EU releases €1.24 billion for Ukrainian-made drones and munitions
entry.content: The European Union has released €1.24 billion for Ukraine to buy drones, drone interceptors, drone ammunition and munitions manufactured domestically in a bid to push back against Russia's ongoing and escalated air attacks.

entry.content: Cemil Tugay, who won İzmir for the CHP with a 314,000-vote margin in 2024, received his AK Party badge from Erdoğan in Ankara on Wednesday, ending 27 years of centre-left rule in Turkey's third-largest city.
